title: Buses through the depot's bays
heading: The Job Shop Is One NoOverlap per Machine and One Precedence Row per Step
cases: every step of every bus gets a whole-number start hour
buses that each use one bay of their own all start at hour 0
two steps on the same bay never overlap, even when they belong to different buses
a bus's next step starts only when its previous step has ended, and the depot still clears as early as possible
